# Third-party notices

Blueprint itself is MIT-licensed (see LICENSE at the repo root). Release
binaries statically link the Go modules below. Each module's full license
text ships in its source distribution; the exact license-file contents are
content-hashed in `licenses.lock`, and CI fails on any drift
(`tools/licensecheck`).

| Module | Version | License |
|--------|---------|--------|
| example.com/alpha | v1.2.3 | MIT |
| example.com/beta | v0.9.0 | Apache-2.0 |
| example.com/gamma | v2.0.0-rc.1 | Apache-2.0 / MIT |

Generated by `go run ./tools/thirdparty` from `licenses.lock`. Regenerate
whenever dependencies change; the file is committed so offline artifacts
can include it without a toolchain.
